title: A week of every bus and tram in London
description:
A week of every bus and tram in London, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside Greater London are faded and not counted. Colours: Bus, Superloop, Night bus and Tram, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 6,573 vehicles, Friday at 3:55 pm.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable. October 24 and October 25 are left out because the clocks change. Transport for London has fewer than three usable October Saturdays and Sundays, so its Saturday and Sunday each use one typical date.
